newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers unchanged in very thin market.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers unchanged in very thin market.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices were largely unchanged from last Thursday in quiet talks with some traders still away from their desk, industry sources said on Tuesday.
Talks were dampened further by a holiday in Japan, traders said. Bunker 180-cst was quoted notionally at $107-$109 and 380-cst at $101-$103 a tonne.
"We would rather wait for the rest of the players to come back before quoting any firm numbers," said a seller.
MDO and gas oil were quoted at $190-$195 and $200-$205 respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870 3082)
